name: Turn-Based Tactics
description: Grid combat where the turn is a budget and position is the argument: initiative orders the units, action points price their verbs, the grid prices their steps, and cover prices their mistakes. TypeChart ships here and is shared forward with the Monster Taming pack.
loop: scout → position units → action economy per turn → objective

signatureCompound.name: The Turn Loop
signatureCompound.description: turn_order_queue announces whose turn it is, action_point_economy hands them a budget, grid_movement_range shows where the budget walks, and cover_bonus_grid prices every shot taken along the way. One full turn through these four is the entire genre in miniature.
